# Federico Vinocur

> Federico (Fede) Vinocur is a film director, videographer and location scout based in Paris, France. He makes fashion films, commercials and brand films, works as a local videographer and crew for international agencies in Paris and France, and photographs locations for film, advertising, fashion and editorial productions. He works in English, French and Spanish.

Freelance since 2016, born and raised in Argentina, based in Paris. Available across Paris and Île-de-France, and to travel anywhere for specific projects.

In French: réalisateur et vidéaste à Paris, repérage et photographie de lieux de tournage. In Spanish: director y videógrafo en París, scouting de locaciones.

## Film and video

He directs, shoots and edits, alone or with a larger crew: fashion films, commercials, brand films, behind the scenes and documentary-driven work. For international agencies he works as a local videographer and crew in Paris and France, with his own equipment.

Worked with: Canva, Lancel (via L'Associé), Amazon (via Dreamtek), Harper's Bazaar, the Paris 2024 Olympic Games (via Digital Video), Les Restos du Cœur, CineMigrante.

- [Portfolio](https://fedevinocur.com/en/): selected films
- [About](https://fedevinocur.com/en/#about): who he is and how he works
- [Contact](https://fedevinocur.com/en/#contact): email and WhatsApp
- [Vimeo](https://vimeo.com/fedevinocur): his films

## Location scouting

Location scouting photography in Paris and Île-de-France for film, advertising, fashion and editorial productions. Each set of images shows what decides a location: light, proportions, how the space flows, technical access and narrative potential, so production teams can evaluate a place at a glance. Photo series are delivered ready to use within 48 hours.

- [Location scouting portfolio](https://scout.fedevinocur.com/): locations photographed in Paris and Île-de-France
